title: Analista de Tesouraria Júnior
description:
Descrição da vaga
#VemSerMAG
Se você quer trabalhar com propósito, desenvolver sua carreira, mas sem deixar de lado sua saúde e bem-estar, a MAG é o seu lugar Temos em nosso DNA a inovação e o cuidado com as pessoas. Desde 2016 estamos na lista das melhores empresas para se trabalhar, segundo a Great Place to Work.
Somos uma empresa PLURAL
Diversidade e inclusão estão na pauta constante da MAG. Nos orgulhamos de ser uma companhia formada por mais de 80% de todos os nossos colaboradores pertencentes a, pelo menos, um grupo minorizado. Contamos também com o Plural, programa formal, estruturado e direcionado ao fomento da diversidade e inclusão.
Nosso propósito e valores
Estamos em busca de pessoas que tenham valores alinhados aos nossos: Atitude de dono, História de transformação, Relações duradouras e Ser presente.
Na MAG temos o forte propósito de oferecer soluções financeiras nos diversos momentos de vida de todos os brasileiros. Nos últimos três anos, realizamos o pagamento de mais de R$ 1 bilhão em benefícios a milhares de famílias. Dados como esse que nos levam a ser referência no mercado de Vida e Previdência, com quase 200 anos de atuação ininterrupta no Brasil.
Somos parte do Grupo Aegon, um dos maiores grupos de Seguro de Vida e Previdência do mundo. No Brasil, nossa força também impressiona: temos mais de 5,8 milhões de vidas seguradas e crescemos, em média, 16% ao ano na última década.
Quer fazer parte dessa história? Conheça a nossa oportunidade.
Responsabilidades e atribuições
Quais serão seus desafios:
Analisar a aprovar/recusar as solicitações de pagamentos à fornecedores, reembolsos, prestações de contas de adiantamentos, cartões corporativos, fundos fixos e demais obrigações da companhia;
Conferir notas fiscais, contratos e documentos de suporte, assegurando conformidade fiscal, tributária e contratual;
Analisar a aprovar/recusar o cadastro de fornecedores para pagamento;
Realizar atendimento, esclarecendo dúvidas sobre pagamentos, documentação e prazos;
Garantir o cumprimento dos prazos de pagamento, respeitando fluxo de caixa, políticas internas e aprovações de alçada;
Apoiar nas atualizações periódicas das políticas internas da Tesouraria e áreas relacionadas;
Apoiar auditorias internas e externas, fornecendo documentação e evidências quando solicitado;
Contribuir para melhoria contínua dos processos, mitigando riscos, gargalos e oportunidades de automação.
Requisitos e qualificações
O que esperamos de você:
Formação superior completa em Administração, Ciências Contábeis, Economia ou áreas correlatas;
Vivência prévia na área financeira (Tesouraria/Contas a pagar e receber);
Conhecimento em Excel no mínimo intermediário;
Noções de impostos indiretos e retenções (ISS, INSS, IRRF, PIS/COFINS, conforme aplicável);
Noções de controles internos, compliance e governança;
Disponibilidade para atuação híbrida, presencialmente de 4 a 8 vezes por mês no Centro do Rio de Janeiro. Caso seja colaborador(a) da MAG e resida fora do Rio, a atuação deverá ocorrer em unidade da MAG mais próxima à residência, na mesma frequência.
Será um diferencial se você possuir:
Desejável conhecimento sobre Reforma Tributária, especialmente os impactos operacionais no processamento de notas e pagamentos (Split Payment);
Atuação integrada com áreas fiscal, contábil e financeira;
Experiência com grandes volumes de processamento e análise de pagamentos.

Há mais de 190 anos temos como propósito prover soluções financeiras individuais nos diversos momentos de vida de todos os brasileiros.

title: Brazil IIntegrated Services
description:
Would you like to be part of the Integrated Well Services team?

Are you a Program Manager looking for a new opportunity?

Join our Integrated Well Services team

Baker Hughes is the leading energy technology company, who delivers across the energy value chain through our market-leading business segments. Built on a century of experience and conducting business in over 120 countries. Our innovative technologies and services are taking energy forward Making it safer, cleaner and more efficient for people and the planet.

Partner with the best

The Program Manager is responsible for planning, executing, and overseeing multiple related projects within a program to achieve strategic business objectives.

As an Integrated Services & Solutions Senior Program Manager, you will be responsible for:

  • Defining program objectives, scope, and success criteria aligned with business and operational goals.
  • Developing and maintain program roadmaps, timelines, and budgets for drilling, completions, and production projects
  • Overseeing execution of multiple projects, ensuring compliance with HSE standards and operational excellence

  • Acting as the primary point of contact for internal teams, customers, and third-party vendors.

Fuel your passion

To be successful in this role you will:

  • Have higher education in Engineering, Petroleum, or related field
  • Have proven experience minimum 10 yeas within Oil & Gas or Energy sector. Managing operations, multidisciplinary teams
  • Have experience with integrated operations
  • Have solid leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Have ability to manage budgets, timelines, and complex operational interdependencies.
  • Have proficiency in project management tools and industry-specific software.

Work in a way that works for you

We recognize that everyone is different and that the way in which people want to work and deliver at their best is different for everyone too. In this role, we can offer the following flexible working patterns:

  • Occasional remote working as required
  • Flexibility within the day or week to get the job done

Working with us

Our people are at the heart of what we do at Baker Hughes. We know we are better when all of our people are developed, engaged and able to bring their whole authentic selves to work. We invest in the health and well-being of our workforce, train and reward talent and develop leaders at all levels to bring out the best in each other.

Working for you

Our inventions have revolutionized energy for over a century. But to keep going forward tomorrow, we know we have to push the boundaries today. We prioritize rewarding those who embrace change with a package that reflects how much we value their input. Join us, and you can expect:

  • Contemporary work-life balance policies and wellbeing activities
  • Comprehensive private medical care options
  • Safety net of life insurance and disability programs
  • Tailored financial programs
  • Additional elected or voluntary benefits

About Us:

We are an energy technology company that provides solutions to energy and industrial customers worldwide. Built on a century of experience and conducting business in over 120 countries, our innovative technologies and services are taking energy forward – making it safer, cleaner and more efficient for people and the planet.

Join Us:

Are you seeking an opportunity to make a real difference in a company that values innovation and progress? Join us and become part of a team of people who will challenge and inspire you Let's come together and take energy forward.

O Grupo FQM é uma empresa da Indústria Farmacêutica que atua há 93 anos no Brasil (desde 1992), faz parte do Grupo Roemmers, multinacional com sede na Argentina, posicionado entre os cinco maiores grupos farmacêuticos da América Latina. No Brasil, a FQM ocupa a 12ª posição do ranking da Indústria Farmacêutica com faturamento acima de 2 bilhões de reais ao ano. A FQM, com mais de 1500 colaboradores, vem escrevendo sua história através de constante aprimoramento do seu portfólio de produtos e processos e da busca incessante pela inovação e excelência para atender às necessidades do mercado farmacêutico no país, promovendo Saúde, Autoestima, Bem-estar e Qualidade de Vida à toda população.

  • Modelo C4 / documentação arquitetural viva;
  • Otimização de consultas complexas;
  • Uso de linters (pylint), formadores (black/ruff/isort) e tipagem gradual (mypy);
  • Observabilidade (CloudWatch);
  • Conhecimento em otimização de geração de grandes arquivos em streaming (Excel).

ATRIBUIÇÕES

  • Evoluir e manter uma solução, garantindo qualidade, performance, segurança e escalabilidade, operando tanto no backend (Django + DRF + PostgreSQL) quanto no frontend (templates Django, JavaScript) e nas integrações (SAP, S3);

  • Implementar e manter exportações Excel (openpyxl) com regras de negócio complexas;
  • Integrar e monitorar rotinas de sincronização com sistemas externos (ex.: SAP);

    • Garantir integridade e segurança do sistema de permissões e perfis;
  • Contribuir com testes automatizados (pytest / unittest Django) e manter a cobertura mínima acordada;
  • Revisar PRs, propor melhorias arquiteturais e seguir padrões internos (lint, estrutura de apps, internacionalização);
  • Diagnosticar e otimizar gargalos de performance (DB, IO, memória, consultas N+1, websockets);
  • Evoluir gradualmente o frontend (melhor UX, modularização JS, possível modernização futura);
  • Apoiar pipeline CI/CD, conteinerização (Docker / docker-compose) e execução local consistente;
  • Documentar: endpoints, fluxos críticos, decisões técnicas e diagramas (C4 / README's técnicos);

title: Engenheiro de Poços Sênior
description:
Descrição da vaga

Somos a PRIO, a maior companhia independente de óleo e gás do Brasil. Buscamos continuamente por otimização de processos operacionais e de soluções inovadoras que visem diminuir os custos. Aqui todo trabalho é multidisciplinar e cada desafio é único

Estamos em busca de um(a) Engenheiro(a) de Poços Sênior para integrar a área de Engenharia de Poços, atuando de forma estratégica e técnica no planejamento, execução e otimização de poços offshore no Brasil, abrangendo poços subsea e surface.

Esse(a) profissional será responsável pelo ciclo completo do poço, desde as fases de conceito e planejamento até a execução, acompanhamento operacional e pós-poço, garantindo segurança, integridade, eficiência operacional e aderência a custos e cronogramas, em alinhamento com padrões corporativos e regulatórios.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Planejar, projetar e revisar programas de perfuração, completação e intervenção de poços subsea e surface, considerando requisitos técnicos, operacionais, econômicos e de HSE.
  • Atuar no acompanhamento técnico da execução offshore, suportando operações de perfuração, revestimento, cimentação, completação e testes, garantindo conformidade com o programa aprovado.
  • Avaliar riscos operacionais (well integrity, controle de poço, stuck pipe, perdas, estabilidade do poço) e implementar estratégias de mitigação alinhadas às melhores práticas da indústria.
  • Interface técnica com equipes de Operações, Subsea, Geologia, Reservatórios, SMS, Suprimentos e fornecedores de serviços (drilling contractors, service companies).
  • Liderar ou apoiar análises técnicas, revisões de projeto (DWOPs, peer reviews), AARs (After Action Reviews) e iniciativas de melhoria contínua.
  • Suportar processos de contratação e gestão de fornecedores, incluindo definição de escopo técnico, avaliação de propostas, acompanhamento de desempenho e controle de custos.
  • Contribuir para a padronização de processos, especificações técnicas, lições aprendidas e indicadores de desempenho (KPIs) de poços.
  • Garantir conformidade com requisitos regulatórios locais (ANP, IBAMA, Marinha) e padrões internos de governança e segurança de poços.

Requisitos e qualificações

Formação acadêmica;

  • Graduação completa em Engenharia (Petróleo, Mecânica, Química, Civil).

Experiência prévia;

  • Experiência sólida em Engenharia de Poços offshore no Brasil.
  • Vivência comprovada em campanhas de perfuração em águas profundas e ultraprofundas.

Qualificações necessárias

  • Conhecimento aprofundado em projetos de poços, controle de poço, integridade de poços e gestão de riscos.
  • Capacidade de atuar de forma integrada com múltiplas disciplinas e liderar discussões técnicas complexas.
  • Boa comunicação, organização, pensamento analítico e habilidade para tomada de decisão em ambientes operacionais.
  • Conhecimento em análise de desempenho operacional, AFE, estimativas de custo e acompanhamento de budget de poços.
  • Experiência com ferramentas e softwares de engenharia de poços (ex.: WellPlan, Wellcat, DrillPlan, Landmark, Drillbench ou similares).

Informações adicionais

Como é o processo seletivo na PRIO?
Gostamos de já chegar na entrevista te conhecendo um pouco, então pedimos a você que preencha ainda na etapa de cadastro alguns testes para podermos avaliar o seu Match com a nossa Cultura :)

Depois, nós do time de RH vamos marcar um papo com você. A ideia aqui é aprofundar um pouco mais nas suas experiências, buscando o alinhamento com o perfil da vaga e comportamental que buscamos para a PRIO. Ah, nesse papo também vamos falar sobre a companhia, fluxo do processo, benefícios e tirar suas dúvidas

Dica:
Nesse nosso papo, vamos querer saber sobre experiências que você já vivenciou, alinhadas aos valores da PRIO. A ideia é que você consiga nos apresentar essas vivências de forma completa, com contextos, sua responsabilidade, o que você fez e qual foi o resultado

Em seguida, vamos adentrando em aspectos mais técnicos, que podem envolver um case ou apenas uma entrevista com o(a) gestor(a) da vaga, aonde você poderá conhecer um pouco mais sobre os desafios técnicos da vaga e será avaliado dentro dos requisitos da vaga.

Ao fim, os finalistas conversam com o diretor da respectiva área para a escolha final

Como se preparar para o processo seletivo na PRIO:

  • Pesquise sobre o negócio da companhia e nossa atuação no setor de óleo e gás;
  • Busque se atualizar sobre as notícias recentes da companhia, sejam da imprensa ou divulgadas em nosso site de relações com investidores;
  • Acesses nossas redes sociais para conhecer mais sobre como é trabalhar na PRIO
  • Pense na sua história e principais realizações. Estruture seus resultados e conquistas para relatá-los na hora da entrevista.

Fale dos sucessos, mas entender as falhas e como você aprendeu com elas também é importante. Prezamos pela transparência, por isso, não tenha medo de falar sobre os seus insucessos.

Desejamos a você um bom processo seletivo

Venha fazer parte da PRIO

Somos a PRIO, a maior companhia independente de óleo e gás do Brasil. Buscamos continuamente por otimização de processos operacionais e de soluções inovadoras que visem diminuir os custos. Aqui todo trabalho é multidisciplinar e cada desafio é único

Com foco no investimento e na recuperação de ativos em produção, somos especializados na gestão eficiente de reservatórios e no redesenvolvimento de campos maduros. Acreditamos na condução dos negócios, com foco em segurança e cuidado com a saúde dos seus colaboradores.

Nosso ambiente de trabalho
Oferecemos um ambiente de trabalho dinâmico e com muitas oportunidades de participação em diferentes projetos, favorecendo o desenvolvimento profissional e o crescimento do time. Trabalhamos em um escritório
open space
, o que permite a integração entre todas as equipes e a Diretoria, onde todos podem participar da tomada de decisões.

Nossa cultura busca o alto desempenho e a participação efetiva de todas as pessoas. Se você sonha em se desenvolver junto com uma empresa em constante crescimento, venha fazer parte do nosso time

Contribute to the organization's ability to deliver resources and services in a risk-based, timely and reliable manner.
You are utilizing your knowledge independently to solve highly complex tasks with a short to medium-term tactical impact/risk. You address key business challenges that align with Equinor's short and long-term strategy via providing specialist support to your team and others.​ ​You independently communicate within the immediate team, across other areas, and towards key stakeholders from partners or external parties. You regularly navigate conflicting agendas and may lead negotiations with senior stakeholders. You resolve challenges, deliver improvements and contribute to shaping best practices. You promote change initiatives, demonstrate flexibility to adopt new highly complex activities/ways of working and advice others.​ You follow and comply with safety, ethics, and compliance requirements and align with leadership expectations and company values. Full band description can be found on Insight. ​

What will my tasks be?

Within this position, your key tasks will be to:

  • Monitor and report on monthly Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) and follow-up actions to enhance operational performance. 

  • Drive initiatives aimed at improving aviation processes and procedures. 

  • Review and update operational procedures periodic to ensure compliance with industry standards and regulations. Stay updated on relevant aviation legislation and ensure compliance across operations. 

  • Follow up with air operator regarding maintenance planning and maintain an action log. 

  • Close follow up with Flight safety department in Norway. Set up and follow up on the annual flight safety verification process to ensure adherence to safety protocols. 

  • Identify cost accrual opportunities and implement reduction initiatives to optimize budget efficiency. 

  • Monitor and report on fleet availability to ensure optimal operational readiness. 

  • Collaborate with relevant stakeholders to enhance air traffic management and operational flow. 

Here's what we expect from you:

At Equinor, there are some overall qualities we regard as essential. We want you to identify with the values that guide our decisions and help us succeed and grow: open, collaborative, courageous and caring. We expect you to make safety your priority and to contribute to our zero-harm culture. And for this specific position, we are also looking for:

  • Minimum 10 years of relevant experience with aviation logistics. Bachelor's degree preferably in Mechanical or Aeronautical Engineering or related areas. 

  • At least 5 years of experience in helicopter maintenance and operations/logistics, OR similar field of study with proven experience in aviation engineering. 

  • Fluent in Portuguese and in English (written and spoken). 

  • Resilient, Communicative, great orator.

  • Collaborative spirit – focus on finding solutions alongside their team. Loves working as a team.

  • Proven experience in monitoring and analyzing aviation-related KPIs. 

  • Experience in reviewing and updating operational procedures in compliance with industry standards. 

  • Experience in maintenance planning and aircraft management. 

  • Ability to work under pressure attending multiple stakeholders. 

What can we offer you?

We want you to have a rewarding and fulfilling work life. That's why we offer:

Not just a job - a career

In Equinor, your development begins on day one. You will build your competence through a wide range of learning activities while being empowered to build your career across multiple disciplines and geographies. Our internal job market allows a wide range of opportunities for development and growth within your own field, or even in other areas you find interesting and relevant.

Attractive rewards

We give you a comprehensive benefits package with a competitive salary, global parental leave, bonus scheme and pension plan.

Wellness and work-life balance

We care about and prioritise our employees' well-being. We know that for you to be the best version of yourself in the workplace, being able to collect your children, attend a class or simply enjoy social time can be invaluable. That's why we encourage you to make use of our flexible work arrangements wherever possible.

An inclusive culture

We believe embracing our differences makes us stronger. For us, true inclusion means being able to bring your whole self to work, and for you and everyone else to feel accepted and valued.

Equal opportunities for everyone

Equinor is an equal-opportunity employer. We make all employment decisions, which include hiring, promotion, transfer, demotion, termination, and training, without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, marital status, parental status, veteran status, or any other protected status. 

As part of this commitment, reasonable adjustments will be made during the recruitment process for candidates with disabilities or long-term health conditions. If you have any specific requirements, please clarify this in your application and our team will be in contact to see how we can support your needs. 

Important notes about the application process

We expect you to openly offer all relevant information about yourself during the recruitment process. Background checks are performed on all final candidates, and all permanent and temporary hires will be screened using relevant sanctions lists to ensure compliance with sanctions laws. When applying for a job in Norway you will be asked for information on affiliation to high-risk countries for a security assessment.

About Equinor

Equinor is an international energy company headquartered in Norway, energising the lives of 170 million people worldwide. Our ambition is to be a leading company in the energy transition and achieve net zero by 2050. Our task is enormous: supplying the world with the energy it needs, while lowering emissions to the atmosphere. To achieve it, we are looking for like-minded people to join our team of 25,000 colleagues working in more than 20 countries. We're up for the challenge. Are you?

title: Offshore Maintenance Team Lead
description:
Imagine your career taking you to the depths of innovation and the heights of impact.  Our people enable continuous progress. Their commitment, collective expertise, and unique capabilities are the engine room behind SBM Offshore's True. Blue. Transition. - shaping the future of energy, and beyond.
About Us:
SBM Offshore is the world's deepwater ocean-infrastructure expert. Our work is already resulting in cleaner, more efficient energy production. True. Blue. Transition. is our promise to enable that into the future while at the same time using our expertise to support new and existing markets in the blue economy. It starts with Advancing our Core: continuing to advance the decarbonization of traditional energy production. While Pioneering More: helping to enable the energy transition and using our unique capabilities in ocean infrastructure to support more industries to grow sustainably.  Sharing our experience for a better blue tomorrow.

Purpose


  • As Maintenance Lead, you are responsible for managing and executing the maintenance activities of an offshore unit. This role involves overseeing the maintenance backlog, coordinating with the maintenance superintendent and team, and ensuring that resources are effectively mobilized for major maintenance tasks. You are also responsible for maintaining the integrity of maintenance data, monitoring key performance indicators (KPIs), and supporting both corrective and planned maintenance efforts to ensure operational efficiency and safety.

    • Responsibilities


  • You manage the maintenance backlog for a specific offshore unit, ensuring that tasks are prioritized and executed efficiently.
  • You align with the Maintenance Superintendent and team to develop and implement strategies for effective backlog management.
  • You plan and mobilize resources for major maintenance activities, ensuring all necessary personnel, tools, and materials are available.
  • You coordinate with offshore supervisors and superintendents to ensure technical competency and effective execution of maintenance tasks.
  • You oversee the execution of routine maintenance offshore, ensuring adherence to safety and quality standards.
  • You update and maintain the unit's maintenance budget master plan, providing regular reports on progress and financial performance.
  • You ensure that the maintenance system is accurately populated with data, including the correct logging of corrective maintenance tasks.
  • You monitor the unit's maintenance KPIs to ensure that maintenance activities are aligned with operational goals and performance standards.
  • You approve purchase requisitions and oversee the CR (Change Request) process to ensure timely and appropriate procurement and maintenance adjustments.
  • You ensure that offshore supervisors and superintendents possess the necessary technical skills and knowledge to perform their duties effectively.
  • You develop and define the scope of work for planned shutdowns, ensuring that all maintenance activities are well-coordinated and executed.

    • Education


  • Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Industrial Engineering,, Metallurgical/Materials Engineering or Automation Engineering.

    • Experience

    Monitoring performance and compliance Workforce planning Analytics and reporting Cost Control and performance management execution Integrity and Reliability - Computarized Maintenance Management System Sub-contracting Change Management Risk Management Planning

title: Senior Manager, Catering
description:
Description


FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women's sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women's World Cup 2027 ("FWWC2027") that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION


The FIFA Women's World Cup 2027 (FWWC2027) will take place in June and July 2027, across eight stadiums in Brazil.

Reporting to the Head of Venue Operations, the Senior Catering Manager is responsible for the efficient organization of catering operations for FWWC2027 and all competition-related events. This includes catering services at competition and non-competition venues for multiple client groups such as workforce, media, broadcast, teams, match officials, ceremonies, and youth programmes, in close collaboration with all stakeholders.

The Senior Catering Manager will act as the first point of contact for all key deliverables related to catering services within venues, including sustainability, hygiene, kitchen equipment, space allocation, venue operations, etc. The role ensures consistency of in-venue catering across the tournament, meeting agreed quality standards at all venues.

This position requires effective and efficient management of catering operations, seamless coordination with FIFA's functional areas, and engagement with internal and external stakeholders. Key areas of focus include transparency, communication, problem-solving, innovation, issue escalation, and the use of reporting tools to guarantee operational excellence.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Plan and execute catering operations for multiple client groups during the FWWC and its competition-related events
  • Develop and coordinate catering service concepts aligned with client expectations and service levels.
  • Establish working relationships with key stakeholders, including public authorities such as ANVISA.
  • Produce technical specifications for catering requirements, equipment, and spaces to provide the required service at competition and no competition venues
  • Conduct full inventory of catering spaces and kitchen equipment at each venue and assign them per FIFA requirements.
  • Define strategic, operational, and technical requirements for catering tenders and procurement procedures to select catering for each stadium and any other relevant sites.
  • Provide operational input to the catering budget and oversee its execution.
  • Ensure project budgeting, reporting, and post-event debriefing for catering operations
  • Work closely with appointed venue caterers, FIFA functional areas, and stakeholders to ensure high-quality catering services
  • Negotiate measurable KPIs with caterers and ensure menu options are tested and meet quality standards for all user groups.
  • Oversee food safety and quality assurance of catering operations across all venues.
  • Integrate catering operational plans into overall venue plans.
  • Identify and mitigate risks across venues.

YOUR PROFILE


Education

  • University degree in appropriate subject (or adequate training/vocational education).
  • Bilingual - Brazilian Portuguese and English
  • Strong administrative and IT skills including MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).

Experience

  • Minimum of 8 years delivering catering services at international sporting events.
  • Proven strong record of experience in organizing catering services for complex events involving multiple venues, stakeholders and authorities.
  • Strong knowledge of local food and beverage regulations, including food safety standards applicable to sporting events.
  • Knowledge of event planning and event project management processes.
  • Excellent customer service experience, with references for excellence.
  • High level of presentation and negotiating skills
  • Excellent oral and written communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently and lead teams without formal reporting structure
  • Experience in budgeting, financial oversight, and resource management for large-scale events.
  • Excellent communication and crisis management skills, with the ability to remain calm under pressure and provide decisive leadership.
  • Familiarity with the host stadium and its operational environment will be considered an asset
  • Flexibility when faced with ambiguity or constant change
  • Strong IT skill including MS Office (Word, Excel, Visio, PowerPoint)

Skills & Competencies

  • Strong team player with ability to meet tight deadlines.
  • Solution-oriented mindset with resilience and positivity under pressure.
  • Ability to prioritize and manage high workloads during peak periods.
  • Sound judgment and critical problem-solving skills.
  • Effective leadership, motivational, and negotiation skills.
  • High energy, adaptability, and entrepreneurial spirit.
  • Excellent interpersonal skills across diverse stakeholder groups.
  • Cultural awareness and sensitivity, with experience in international contexts.

Certifications & Requirements

  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

About FIFA Women's World Cup 2027


The FIFA Women's World Cup is the greatest women's sporting event on the planet, showcasing the best players in the world on the biggest stage. In 2027, history will be made as Brazil welcomes the tournament to South America for the first time ever.

This landmark event will unite the world through an unprecedented celebration of women's football, inspiring billions of fans across the globe. As we prepare to host teams and supporters from every corner of the world, we're looking for passionate, talented individuals to be part of history and help deliver an unforgettable tournament.

Join us and play your role in making FIFA Women's World Cup 2027 a truly extraordinary experience that celebrates and elevates women's football.

Conheça a empresa Rede D'Or


Fundada em 1977 como "Cardiolab", atualmente conta com 75 hospitais próprios e 3 sob gestão, além de 55 clínicas oncológicas, nos estados do RJ, SP, MG, PE, BA, MA, SE, CE, AL, PB, PR, MS, PA e DF.

Gerencia diferentes marcas, tendo presença mais marcante no Rio de Janeiro, com a marca "D'Or"; em SP, com "São Luiz"; em PE, com "Esperança"; no DF, com "Santa Luzia" e "Santa Helena"; no MA, com "UDI"; na BA, com "São Rafael"; em SE, com "São Lucas"; no PR, com "Santa Cruz"; em MG, com "Biocor", em MS, com "Proncor", em PB, com "Nossa Senhora das Neves", em CE com "São Carlos", além da marca premium "Star" nos estados do RJ, SP e DF.

Em 23 de dezembro de 2022, a proposta de valor da Rede D'Or foi reforçada significativamente com a consumação da combinação de negócios com a SulAmérica – a maior seguradora do Brasil e uma das maiores operadoras de saúde do país. Acreditamos na responsabilidade em contribuir para uma sociedade mais justa, inclusiva e com igualdade de oportunidades, por isso, todas as nossas vagas estão abertas a pessoas de diferentes perfis e contextos, inclusive pessoas com deficiência.

Sobre a Evoltz

Criada em 2018, a Evoltz é responsável pela operação de onze linhas de transmissão, totalizando 3.561km, passando por 10 estados do Brasil. A empresa é hoje uma plataforma operacional de ativos de transmissão de energia, apta a receber novos investimentos.

CMG is seeking a Senior Staff Reservoir Simulation Engineer to join our Customer Success and Consulting team. This is a full-time, permanent position. As part of the growing costumer success and consulting team, the successful candidate will play an active role in delivering high quality consulting, support and training services to end users and customers of CMG in a global setting.
CMG is a worldwide leader in its field, thanks to its great staff who consistently deliver superior technology and unparalleled customer service.
Essential Responsibilities
The successful candidate will work as part of the Customer Success and Consulting team, under the direction of a Team Lead – CSC.
The successful candidate will:
Become very proficient with CMG's software suite, including the graphical pre- and post-processor.
Play an active role in supporting CMG clients who use the software for a variety of challenging and leading-edge petroleum reservoir recovery processes.
Teach advanced reservoir simulation training courses to CMG clients.
Become part of an international consulting team and work on conventional, unconventional, thermal, chemical, compositional and energy transition reservoir studies.
Will get an opportunity to develop broad knowledge and expertise in simulating various enhanced oil and gas recovery processes.
Develop knowledge and expertise in emerging energy transition topics such as subsurface and wellbore modelling of CCS/CO2 Sequestration, geothermal, hydrogen storage, etc.
Provide technical leadership and mentorship to junior engineers within the reservoir simulation team.
Act as a subject matter expert in reservoir simulation, providing guidance and expertise on complex projects and challenging technical issues.
Take a lead role in engaging with clients, understanding their needs, and providing high-level technical support and expertise.
Build and maintain strong client relationships, serving as a trusted advisor and consultant on reservoir simulation matters. Lead and oversee multiple reservoir simulation projects simultaneously, ensuring they are delivered on time, within budget, and to the client's satisfaction.
Coordinate with internal teams, including software development, technical support, and sales, to ensure seamless project execution and delivery.
The above statements are intended only to describe the general nature of the job and should not be construed as an all-inclusive list of position responsibilities.

Civil Engineering, Petroleum Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Geology post-secondary degree or related graduate or post-graduate degree.

Experience in advanced processes such as enhanced oil recovery (EOR) or emerging energy transition processes an asset.
Excellent technical and communication skills and a collaborative approach towards clients and colleagues.
Excellent analytical, troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
Self-motivated, results focused team player with a positive attitude and ability to multi-task in a dynamic work environment.
Ability to clearly advise clients on technical matters.

Be customer focused, learn about the business to help bring value to our customers.
Team focused with a positive attitude, must be self-motivated, and have very good time management and communication skills both in written and verbal English.
Experience

title: Search Engine Marketing
description:
Position is Remote (Canada, or Latin / South America)
No agencies please
Maximus ) is a mission-driven consumer performance medicine company that empowers individuals to achieve their physical and cognitive peak through precision telehealth care. We are a high-growth, profitable company tailored to ambitious people who refuse to settle for average. We are backed by top Silicon Valley VCs such as Founders Fund and 8VC as well as leading angel investors/operators from companies like Bulletproof, Tinder, Coinbase, Daily Stoic, & Shopify.
About The Role
We are looking for a highly technical Paid Search & YouTube Manager who thrives on intent capture, granular data analysis, and scientific rigor. In this role, you will be instrumental in transitioning our SEM and YouTube operations in-house, taking ownership of these critical high-intent channels to help us scale.
You will work directly with the Director of Paid Media to manage, execute, and optimize campaigns primarily on Google (Search & YouTube) and Microsoft (Bing). This role requires an individual who embodies "curiosity"—you never accept "that's just the way it is" or rely solely on automated bidding strategies without oversight. Instead, you dive deep into the Search Query Reports to understand the "why" behind performance. You will be expected to work transparently, sharing work queues and mid-stream insights to ensure alignment.
Key Responsibilities
Own Campaign Execution: Take end-to-end ownership of campaign setup, management, and optimization across Google Ads (Search, YouTube, Discovery/Demand Gen) and Microsoft Ads. You will lead the transition of these responsibilities from our current agency partners
Master Intent & Keywords: Meticulously manage keyword strategy. You will move beyond simple broad match reliance to build robust negative keyword lists, structure high-intent ad groups, and maximize Quality Score to improve efficiency.
Drive YouTube Performance: Treat YouTube as a direct-response performance channel. You will collaborate with the creative team to iterate on video hooks, pacing, and CTAs based on retention rates and conversion data, not just vanity view metrics.
Scientific A/B Testing: Rigorous A/B testing of headlines, descriptions, and extensions, and landing pages.
Master Attribution: Utilize internal analytics and multi-touch attribution (MTA) tools alongside platform data to triangulate performance.
Analyze & Iterate: Assist in the set-up and evaluation geo holdout tests to prove incrementality.
Work Transparently: Maintain visible work queues and rigorous reporting standards. You will prepare data for weekly paid media performance reviews to discuss budget shifts, CPA targets, and anomalies.
Qualifications
Platform Expertise: Deep, hands-on mastery of Google Ads and Microsoft Advertising is non-negotiable. You must have a track record of scaling direct-response accounts in a D2C environment.
Demand Gen / Youtube Experience: Proven experience managing YouTube for conversions (VAC/Demand Gen), not just brand awareness. You understand how to buy YouTube traffic that converts.
Tech Stack: Proficiency with 1st party analytics tools is essential (GA4, Looker, Tableau or the like). Preferred experience with (or similar tools to) MTA platforms (Northbeam, Triple Whale), and experience implementing tracking pixels (GTM).
Resourcefulness: You are scrappy. You use the tools in front of you to prove value and are willing to track down the information you need rather than waiting for it to be handed to you.
Data-Driven Mindset: You base your decisions on numbers, ROAS/CAC targets, and data, not assumptions.
Nice To Haves
Experience in the Health & Wellness, Telehealth, or Biohacking space.
Proven success utilizing Google Scripts or automated rules to streamline optimizations.
Experience using AI tools (Claude, GoMarble, Gemini) for platform strategy and analysis.
World-Class Benefits
Flexible vacation/time-off policies - we manage energy, not time and promote work life flexibility
Exposure to top-tier leadership and a meritocratic culture where the best ideas win regardless of title.
Opportunity to work with a high-growth, science-backed brand changing the landscape of performance medicine.
Opportunity to make a meaningful impact on people's health and wellness
Fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment with significant growth opportunities
Extended options exercise window for loyal employees (3 months for every year of service; e.g. 1 year for 4+ year employees)
Liquidity of options whenever available
Maximus is an equal opportunity employer, which not only includes standard protected categories, but the additional freedom from discrimination against your free speech and beliefs, as long as they are aligned with company values. We celebrate intellectual diversity.
Note: We utilize AI note-taking technology during our interview sessions to ensure we capture all answers and details accurately. Candidates are also encouraged to use AI note-takers for their own records if they wish.

title: Quality Engineer, Product QA
description:
Would you thrive in a role where technical rigor, product assurance and collaboration with cross‑functional manufacturing teams ensure flawless execution of in‑house production?
Would you bring the critical thinking, discipline and problem‑solving mindset needed to drive continuous improvement in fabrication, assembly and product validation processes?
Join our Quality Team
At Baker Hughes, Quality is essential to delivering safe, reliable and high-performing products. Our Product QA team ensures alignment with the Quality Management System (QMS), customer requirements and industry standards across internal manufacturing operations.
Partner with the best
As a Quality Engineer, Product QA (In-house Curitiba), you will ensure technical requirements are properly implemented and verified throughout fabrication, assembly and validation activities inside our Curitiba plant. You will support audits, risk assessments, first article inspections, non‑conformance management and continuous improvement initiatives to guarantee flawless execution.
As the Quality Engineer, Product QA (In-house Curitiba) you will be responsible for:
Reviewing and improving in-house product quality performance on a frequent basis.
Collaborating with Lean initiatives to enable process improvements and flawless execution.
Leading first article inspection (FAI) processes internally, ensuring product and process alignment with requirements using risk assessment tools such as FMEA.
Conducting product quality audits and performing routine Gemba walks to validate compliance to technical specifications.
Acting as a risk assessor for manufacturing processes and mitigating identified execution risks.
Supporting and/or leading Go/No-Go reviews and facilitating pre-production meetings.
Capturing, resolving and communicating operational Lessons Learned to Supply Chain and Product Delivery teams.
Promoting quality culture by conducting continuous improvement workshops.
Identifying, reviewing and addressing product non-conformances and driving strategic corrective actions.
Implementing and monitoring product Key Performance Indicators (KPIs).
Communicating approaches and methods for solving complex quality issues.
Ensuring adherence to Product Line quality directives at fabrication sites.
Witnessing in-house product inspections and qualification activities.
Registering and escalating critical observations to the appropriate levels of the organization.
Leading manufacturing review processes for new first articles with relevant stakeholders.
Acting as an enabler for implementing Non‑Conformance Management processes within internal operations.
Fuel your passion
To be successful in this role you will:
Have a Bachelor's degree in Mechanical or Production Engineering.
Have fluent English skills.
Have knowledge of Brazilian customer quality requirements for subsea equipment fabrication (XT, Manifolds, Tooling).
Have previous experience in Quality Control for subsea equipment fabrication.
Have experience performing quality and product requirement audits.
Have knowledge in product inspection processes and technical documentation analysis.
Have experience using quality tools such as A3, 8D, 5 Whys, Fishbone, FMEA, 5S and Lean Six‑Sigma.
Have strong leadership skills.
Have negotiation and influencing abilities with internal and external stakeholders.
Have the ability to interpret technical drawings, specifications and quality requirements.
Have a Master's degree in a Quality‑related discipline. (Desirable)
Have technical qualification or certification in Dimensional, Painting, Welding, NDT or Fabrication inspection. (Desirable)
Work in a way that works for you
We recognize that everyone is different and that the way in which people want to work and deliver at their best is different for everyone too. In this role, we can offer the following flexible working patterns:
Working flexible hours - from 7am-4pm or from 8am-5pm.
Location: Curitiba, PR.
Working with us
Our people are at the heart of what we do at Baker Hughes. We know we are better when all of our people are developed, engaged and able to bring their whole authentic selves to work. We invest in the health and well-being of our workforce, train and reward talent and develop leaders at all levels to bring out the best in each other.
Working for you
Our inventions have revolutionized energy for over a century. But to keep going forward tomorrow, we know we have to push the boundaries today. We prioritize rewarding those who embrace change with a package that reflects how much we value their input. Join us, and you can expect:
Contemporary work-life balance policies and wellbeing activities
Comprehensive private medical care options
Safety net of life insurance and disability programs
Tailored financial programs
Additional elected or voluntary benefits
The Baker Hughes internal title for this role is: Quality Senior Specialist - QA Engineering
About Us:
We are an energy technology company that provides solutions to energy and industrial customers worldwide. Built on a century of experience and conducting business in over 120 countries, our innovative technologies and services are taking energy forward – making it safer, cleaner and more efficient for people and the planet.
Join Us:
Are you seeking an opportunity to make a real difference in a company that values innovation and progress? Join us and become part of a team of people who will challenge and inspire you Let's come together and take energy forward.

title: Fonoaudiólogo(a)
description:
MISSÃO:
Diagnosticar, planejar, propor e executar intervenções voltadas para o desenvolvimento de habilidades de linguagem e comunicação em crianças e adolescentes com Transtorno do Espectro Autista (TEA), atuando em equipe interdisciplinar e contribuindo para o desenvolvimento e o bem-estar dos aprendizes neurodiversos.
ATIVIDADES:
Acolhida/Contato Inicial com o Aprendiz, Família, Escola e Equipe Multidisciplinar
Realizar acolhimento inicial das famílias e dos clientes, escutando e legitimando queixas e expectativas para alinhamento com a intervenção proposta.
Coletar e selecionar informações do histórico do indivíduo e da família, bem como dados de equipes multidisciplinares e escolas.
Esclarecer possíveis dúvidas que a família, escola ou equipe interdisciplinar possam ter sobre nosso trabalho.
Avaliação e Desenvolvimento do Plano Terapêutico
Estabelecer vínculo com o cliente antes de iniciar o processo de avaliação, a fim de garantir maior fidedignidade nas análises realizadas.
Planejar e conduzir avaliações fonoaudiológicas utilizando protocolos específicos da área, bem como participar de avaliações interdisciplinares, sob supervisão técnica, assegurando a integração e a coerência das informações coletadas.
Redigir relatórios de avaliação e elaborar planos terapêuticos individualizados junto com a equipe interdisciplinar.
Definir carga horária e local de atendimento do cliente, em conjunto com a equipe interdisciplinar.
Intervenção
Implementar o plano terapêutico individualizado, realizando a seleção, indicação e aplicação de métodos, técnicas e procedimentos terapêuticos adequados para crianças e adolescentes com TEA, com suporte da supervisão técnica.
Aplicar técnicas baseadas em evidências, com ênfase nos métodos voltados para transtornos motores da fala e para comunicação aumentativa e alternativa.
Adaptar e modificar as intervenções conforme necessário, com base no progresso do aprendiz.
Registrar e monitorar o progresso do aprendiz, mantendo registros organizados e atualizados.
Coordenação, Monitoramento e Trabalho em Equipe
Participar ativamente de reuniões e discussões com a equipe interdisciplinar, incluindo terapeutas ABA, coordenadores e supervisores.
Respeitar e colaborar com profissionais de outras áreas, reconhecendo a supervisão do caso pelo supervisor ABA.
Receber supervisão da fonoaudióloga sênior da clínica, implementando feedbacks para aprimorar a prática clínica.
Demonstrar humildade para reconhecer erros e disposição para aprender e crescer profissionalmente.
Orientar e fornecer suporte às famílias, cuidadores e, quando apropriado, à equipe escolar.
ESCOLARIDADE/FORMAÇÃO:
Ensino superior completo em Fonoaudiologia, com registro ativo no Conselho Regional de Fonoaudiologia (CRFa).
Formação em intervenção motora da fala (PROMPT, DTTC, REST) e CAA (desejável).
Conhecimento em Análise do Comportamento Aplicada (ABA) e TEA.
Cursos complementares em Motricidade Orofacial e TEA (diferencial).
EXPERIÊNCIA PROFISSIONAL:
Experiência anterior de 6 meses na área.

title: Dynamics 365 CE Technical Architect
description:
Our client's Microsoft Business Solutions team is a Microsoft Gold Partner and leader in Microsoft software implementations for medium to large organisations, providing their clients with the ability to keep up with the ever-changing digital world by implementing Microsoft's Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) and Customer Engagement (CE) software from the Microsoft Dynamics 365 (D365) software line.

Role Overview

The Dynamics CE Technical Architect is a core team member of our client's customer delivery of Microsoft Dynamics 365 centred solutions. The architect will be involved in the business processes and solution design and will be hands on configuring and customising the implementation of Dynamics CE solutions working with both onshore and offshore development teams. The position may require business travel.

Job Location: Silema, Malta

Work Type: Hybrid

Job Type: Full-time, Permanent

Working Hours: GMT +1

Salary: Base + Benefits (Paid in Euros €)

Relocation: VISA & Relocation Package Included

Requirements

  • A University graduate with relevant degree within a computing or business discipline;
  • Microsoft Dynamics CRM Certifications (2016, D365) & Power Platform Certifications are desirable;
  • Strong technical & functional knowledge and understanding of Microsoft Dynamics CRM and Power Platform stack covering a wide spectrum of industries and sectors;
  • Minimum 10+ years of relevant and proven end to end implementation experience in Dynamics CRM configuration, customization, standard or customized workflows, dashboards, forms, views, integration, custom plugin development, report development;
  • Strong and proven experience in developing solutions that involve Power Platform (including Power Apps like Canvas, Model driven, Power Automate, Power BI, Power Pages, etc.)
  • Detailed knowledge and understanding of all areas within Customer Engagement including Sales, Marketing, Customer Service & Field Services;
  • Good understanding of Dataverse including customisations and development of Business Data Models for different solutions etc.;
  • Good understand of Microsoft Dynamics CRM Accelerators, industry templates and add-ons
  • Proven track record of leading technical team and successfully delivering a number of solutions for medium/ large customers, preferably across a number of business verticals (e.g. healthcare, finance, insurance etc.);
  • Proven ability to develop a clear understanding of clients' needs and the ability to incorporate them into a solution following effective design approach;
  • Experience of consultancy roles in software delivery;
  • Experience in a delivery-orientated IT environment using waterfall, agile and DevOps methodologies;
  • Adept at business requirement analysis, solution design, development, system verification and deployment strategies;
  • Ability to see the bigger picture and suggest solutions both within and outside the current implementation;
  • Experience in creation of demos, supporting pre-sales activities is an advantage;
  • Business process mapping, Fit Gap analysis, work package estimation, work breakdown structure, modelling and documentation experience;
  • Excellent understanding of Dynamics CRM DB Schema and Business Data Model including the customisation and development of Business Data Models for different solutions;
  • Broad understanding of software development lifecycle, development management, release management, data migrations, cut-over planning and hyper care support;
  • Strong knowledge of Azure DevOps & CI/CD pipelines;
  • Knowledge and understanding of .NET framework including extensive experience writing ASP.NET and C# code (not just limited to plugins/custom workflows) is a plus;
  • Additional Technical Skills: PCF Component development, TypeScript, Unit Testing of TypeScript/JavaScript, Unit Testing of .Net Plugins, Core technical skills, i.e. use of git for source control.

Responsibilities

The Technical Architect will work to implement various modules of Dynamics CRM working closely with client teams and business stakeholders.

  • Organise, execute, manage and document workshops, meetings and requirements sessions with the client representatives, project stakeholders, business analysts and consulting team;
  • Interface effectively with other members of the consulting team to arrive at best in class solution, and provide a sustainable and scalable solution architecture and application to meet client's requirements;
  • Deliver high quality business and software solutions & services to clients ensuring the implementation of best practices based on Microsoft Dynamics standards and supported configuration/ customizations;
  • Ensure completeness in meeting business requirements and take accountability for project deliverables including and not limited to project documentation, solution design, performance, reliability, testing features etc;
  • Deliver all consultancy and configuration work according to our project methodology, ensuring that all software applications are implemented successfully according to the SLA: on time and on budget;
  • Maximize usage of OOB features and provide technical design or develop/customize solution approach for identified gaps;
  • Contribute to activities as required including technical presales, building demo and proof of concept solutions for various client presentations;
  • Proactively skilling up on new versions and technology stack to be future ready;
  • Work on the creation of Dynamics 365 solutions and industry templates;
  • Meet and exceed customer expectations of business knowledge, skills and behaviour; Be a trusted advisor for our clients and help to provide solutions which can be upgrade ready;
  • Proactively identify business/ project/ technical/ support risks and provide suggestions to mitigate or communicate as necessary;
  • Proactively communicate progress updates to relevant parties both formally and informally;
  • Support practice development activities such as defining, solutioning and configuring industry specific solutions;
  • Be an active member of technical and design working groups within the practice;
  • In all activities, ensure timely completion of internal processes and mandatory trainings;
  • Drive for process improvement, feature reusability and other initiatives to maximize efficiency in delivery;
  • Carry out additional duties as may occur from time to time as instructed and agreed by the management team or supervisors;
  • Provide guidance and mentorship (technical/professional) to groom junior team members;
  • Represent our client's Microsoft Business Solutions team in a professional and positive manner at all times;
  • The Employee is required to follow our client's Information Security Policies (ISP and ISMP) at all times.

Microsoft Business Solutions Overview

At our client, your long-term future is every bit as important to them as it is to you. That's why our clients aim is to give you experiences that will stay with you for a lifetime. Whether it's great training and development, mobility opportunities or corporate responsibility volunteering activities – you'll gain a wealth of experiences on which to build a rewarding career. Our client is a firm that encourages you to be yourself, values your contribution, and inspires you to act as a role model, always focused on doing the right thing for each other, our clients, and our communities.

This sets out all the different ways you'll be rewarded at our client. Among other things, you can benefit from honest conversations about your career as well as a range of other rewards. In all these ways and more, they have created an environment that can bring out the best in you.

#Bethechange and #makethechange. Join our talented, successful team and make the leap into the future.

For this exciting opportunity they have put together a great package that combines a competitive salary with a bundle of extras including allowances, business travel allowances, certifications to support you in your career growth, private insurance, and medical insurance for you and your family.

Don't worry, our client knows that relocation can be a challenge, which is why they have an extremely supportive onboarding team to help you throughout this process - They provide relocation support for you and your family. Our client is looking forward to meeting you and seeing you grow.

title: Team Lead
description:
We are looking for the right people - people who want to innovate, achieve, grow and lead. We attract and retain the best talent by investing in our employees and empowering them to develop themselves and their careers. Experience the challenges, rewards and opportunity of working for one of the world's largest providers of products and services to the global energy industry.
Job Duties
We are building a platform that merges real-time physics, structured knowledge, and autonomous intelligence. You will be the technical anchor for a team of Senior Engineers handling:
Backend: Ingesting massive sensor streams and running multi-agent AI systems.
Data: Organizing tons of industrial data into a Medallion Architecture.
Frontend: Building the "Control Room" and complex AI interfaces.
DevOps: Deploying across hybrid cloud (AWS/Azure) and edge (K3s) environments.
Your challenge is to ensure these distinct pieces fit together. ensuring the backend model is consumable by the frontend's "Visualizations" and that the "Data Pipelines" are reliably deployed by DevOps.
What You'll Do
Technical Orchestration: You will drive cross-boundary architectural decisions. You will decide how the Backend serves live telemetry to Frontend dashboards and how Data Engineering pipelines feed the Knowledge Graph.
Code & Quality Standards: Enforce high standards across the stack. You will review API designs (FastAPI), ensure the Frontend maintains strict Component Architecture, and verify that Data pipelines implement appropriate quality gates.
The "Expert": When the DevOps engineer faces a connectivity issue between Cloud and On-Prem, or the Backend engineer struggles with concurrency in a distributed stream, you are the senior voice in the room, guiding the solution.
Team Leadership: Conduct code reviews, mentor senior developers, and translating high-level product requirements into technical tasks (ADO) for the squad.
The Technology Stack
You do not need to be an expert in every single tool, but you must be able to discuss technical trade-offs across the entire stack:
Backend: Python FastAPI), Kafka, Neo4j, LangGraph.
Frontend: Angular 16+, TypeScript, RxJS,
Data: Apache Airflow, Delta Lake, Polars/Spark.
Infrastructure: Kubernetes (EKS/AKS/K3s), Terraform, Hybrid Cloud
Qualifications
Desired Profile
The Architect-Implementer: You can draw the system architecture on a whiteboard, but you are not afraid to open an IDE to debug a failing pipeline or a slow query.
The Polyglot: You are likely a Backend or Full-Stack native, but you understand the complexity of Frontend state management (NgRx/Signals) and the constraints of Medallion Data Architectures.
Reliability Mindset: You understand that we are dealing with critical industrial environments. You prioritize testing, validation, and security.
Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities
Must Haves:
10+ years of experience in Software Engineering, with at least 2+ years leading technical teams.
Deep proficiency in Python Backend Development.
Solid understanding of Frontend complexity (SPA architecture, async data loading).
Experience designing or managing Data Intensive Applications (understanding ETL, Streams, or Data Lakes).
Familiarity with DevOps/Cloud concepts (Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD).
Advanced English communication skills.
Good to Have:
Streaming: Proficiency with Streaming Technologies (Kafka, Flink, Spark) and Time-Series Databases (TimescaleDB, InfluxDB).
GenAI: Practical experience building applications with LLMs, Agentic Frameworks (LangGraph), and Vector Databases.
Graph: Hands-on experience with Graph Databases (Neo4j/Cypher), SQL database design, and Hybrid Search strategies
Experience with Digital Twins, IoT, or Industrial Data.
Experience with GenAI/LLM architecture (RAG, Agents).
Background in Heavy Industry, O&G, or IoT data (MQTT, OPC UA).
Experience with Local LLMs (Ollama) for privacy-focused deployments.
Familiarity with Data Lineage or Metadata management.

title: Senior Coating Advisor
description:
Job Title: Senior Coating Advisor

Location: Applicants must reside in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil

Schedule : Remote
Department: Technical Services

Reports To: Area Manager Service Operations, Argentina & Brazil

Travel Requirement: Up to 80% travel, both domestic and international, with a valid US visa.

Important : Please submit CVs in English

Hempel , founded in Denmark in 1915, is a world-leading supplier of trusted coating solutions. Across the globe, our products protect and beautify buildings, infrastructure and other assets, and play an essential role in our customers' businesses. They help minimize maintenance costs, improve aesthetics, and increase energy efficiency. Through our brands Hempel, Neogard, Crown Paints, Wattyl and Farrow & Ball, we provide solutions for the Marine, Energy, Infrastructure and Decorative industries. 

Job Summary:   Hempel is seeking an experienced and technically skilled Senior Coating Advisor to join our Technical Services team in Brazil, within the marine segment. This role is responsible for providing technical advice and support to sales teams, as well as conducting technical analyses of product configurations to determine customer-specific pricing. Key responsibilities include preparing and conducting technical sales briefings for customers and company representatives, researching customer technical specifications, estimating the costs, resources, time, and technical requirements for modifying, configuring, and installing products or solutions, and evaluating sales proposals to ensure they are technically accurate and aligned with the organization's quality standards.

Essential Responsibilities:

  • Fulfill assigned projects in accordance with the requirements of the Work Orders.

  • Advise customers on the correct use of Hempel products and paint systems by following instructions provided in current technical documentation (Product Data Sheets, application instructions, or other relevant technical materials).

  • Ensure compliance with agreed painting specifications, including technical standards, work procedures, and best painting practices.

  • Keep all parties informed of work progress through Progress Reports. In case of deviations or non-conformities, notify the customer in writing, provide recommendations for preventive/corrective actions, and follow up on their implementation.

  • Monitor and control paint inventory for the project, provide timely updates to front/back office sales, and ensure proper implementation of paint consumption planning and procedures.

  • Conduct coating condition surveys onshore and offshore as required.

  • Actively participate in claim handling procedures and assist in their resolution.

  • Provide pre-sales and/or post-sales technical support to customers, including testing and maintaining products, equipment, and services; evaluate and recommend new products or equipment upgrades as needed to meet customer requirements.

  • Monitor and resolve recurring issues to ensure ongoing customer satisfaction.

  • Manage complex and large-scale projects effectively.

  • Train customers on the features and application of purchased products when needed.

  • Ensure quality and timely reporting of all work activities.

  • Support the sales force regarding technical aspects of the company's products and services.

  • Complete all required reports with high quality and on time.

  • Utilize information tools efficiently in accordance with Hempel's procedures.

  • Ensure all Technical Services staff equipment is used according to project procedures and specifications, and that all equipment is calibrated and in good working condition.

  • Comply with training programs to acquire the necessary skills, knowledge, and behaviors.

  • Travel to project sites and prepare/distribute technical reports; travel accounts for approximately 80% of working time, both domestically and internationally.

  • Conduct work safely and responsibly, following Hempel's HSE guidelines and the HSE procedures of each worksite.

  • Use all required personal protective equipment (PPE) and ensure it is always in good condition for the job.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Fluency in Portuguese and English is required; Spanish is a plus.

  • Minimum 2 years of experience as a Coating Advisor in a technical service role, preferably within the marine segment.

  • Relevant certifications such as NACE, FROSIO, ABRACO, or IARCOR.

  • Strong knowledge of the paint and coatings industry.

  • Technologically proficient and comfortable using digital reporting tools.

  • University degree in Chemistry or a related field is a plus.

  • Completion of required internal training as outlined in Hempel's Group Training Policy.

What's in it for you?

100% employer-paid medical coverage for you and your immediate family (spouse and children)

Standard CLT contract benefits, including:

  • Paid vacations

  • 13th salary

  • Severance fund (FGTS)

  • Social security

  • Paid sick leave

  • Company Car

Application due

Seniority Level

Associate

Job Functions

Customer Service, Project Management, Quality Assurance

Industry

Chemicals

At Hempel, you're welcomed to a global community of +7000 colleagues around the world. A workplace built on shared trust, mutual respect and support for each other. 

We're on a mission to double our impact. To succeed, we need bright minds and team players. Which is why, from day one, your input, ideas and initiative are not only welcomed, but expected. In return, you will enjoy great opportunities for development in a growing global company – and be part of the solution by contributing to our global impact. 

At Hempel, we are committed to everyone feeling safe, valued and treated equally, in an environment where each employee can bring their authentic selves to work.  We believe that inclusion is key to innovation and by bringing together the most diverse perspectives and talents,  we can achieve great things, together.

title: Project Engineer
description:
A Brunel está em busca de um Project Engineer para atuar em projetos do setor de óleo & gás e energia, para uma empresa referência no setor.
O profissional será responsável por apoiar o Project Manager na coordenação e entrega de escopos específicos do projeto, liderando atividades técnicas, equipes e interfaces, assegurando o alinhamento aos objetivos do projeto, padrões de segurança, qualidade e desempenho.
Responsabilidades
Planejar, organizar, executar, controlar e reportar atividades e pacotes de trabalho sob sua responsabilidade, conforme diretrizes do Project Manager.
Coordenar equipes técnicas e multidisciplinares, assegurando clareza de escopo, prazos, responsabilidades e objetivos do projeto.
Garantir comunicação eficaz entre stakeholders internos e externos, promovendo o fluxo adequado de informações para suporte à tomada de decisão.
Desdobrar e comunicar os objetivos e metas do projeto à equipe, assegurando alinhamento e entendimento claro das prioridades.
Gerenciar interfaces técnicas e operacionais entre áreas como engenharia, planejamento, construção, suprimentos, qualidade e HSE.
Identificar riscos, apoiar a definição de ações de mitigação e acompanhar a implementação de ações corretivas e preventivas.
Apoiar a resolução de problemas técnicos e operacionais, garantindo o avanço das atividades conforme o plano do projeto.
Elaborar e apresentar relatórios periódicos de progresso, riscos, desvios e indicadores ao Project Manager.
Definir, implementar e monitorar planos de ação relacionados ao escopo sob sua responsabilidade.
Atuar, quando aplicável, como representante nominativo do projeto (internamente) e/ou da empresa (externamente) junto a clientes e parceiros.
Requisitos
Formação superior em Engenharia ou área correlata.
Inglês fluente.
Experiência mínima de 7 anos em funções similares, atuando em projetos.
Conhecimento sólido e experiência prática em gestão de projetos.
Conhecimento geral em disciplinas como HSE, planejamento, construção, qualidade, engenharia e suprimentos.
Experiência em gestão e interface com múltiplos stakeholders.
Vivência em projetos offshore no setor de óleo & gás, como Brownfield, EPC, Flotel, paradas programadas (shutdowns) e projetos de modificação/manutenção.
Experiência em projetos Brownfield será considerada um diferencial.
Certificação PMI ou pós-graduação em Gestão de Projetos será um diferencial.

  • Apoiar a organização de demandas e informações para suporte aos founders.

Roupa boa
até a experiência em loja. Pra gente, é tudo sobre respeito, colaboração e comunicação.

title: Agente de Atendimento Externo
description:
Nascemos em 2017 com o propósito de Ser a Melhor Empresa de Saneamento PARA o Brasil. Hoje, estamos presentes em diversos municípios e estados brasileiros, com o objetivo de contribuir para que o país alcance a universalização dos serviços de água e esgoto.

Nosso modelo de negócios consiste em concessões e parcerias público-privadas (PPPs). Somos uma das principais companhias de saneamento do país, inserida na vida de comunidades de diferentes portes e atendendo milhões de pessoas.

Inovação, sustentabilidade, geração de valor e foco na satisfação do cliente fazem parte da nossa cultura organizacional. Venha fazer parte dessa transformação com a gente

Local de Atuação: Rio de Janeiro, RJ (Iguá Rio de Janeiro S.A).

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Conferir e atualizar cadastros de clientes em campo através do sistema;
  • Levantar as necessidades do cliente, sanando dúvidas, solucionando questões, visando a correta orientação do cliente e contribuindo para a continuidade do negócio;
  • Emitir e entregar faturas de consumo de água;
  • Responsabilizar-se pela conservação e entrega do equipamento de leitura ao responsável do setor;
  • Realizar corte fita (comunicação de interrupção de abastecimento de água) e corte cavalete (interrupção de abastecimento de água –colocação de lacre), no local necessário, atendendo a OS (Ordem de Serviço);
  • Realizar religação de corte cavalete e novas ligações, atendendo a necessidade do cliente;
  • Fazer repasse (revisão de leituras de matrículas – hidrômetros), assegurando informações e números corretos;
  • Realizar fiscalização de autoconsumo;
  • Dirigir veículos da empresa em caso de necessidade de serviço externo, zelando pela segurança e normas de trânsito estabelecidas;
  • Realizar serviços no cavalete no geral, incluindo instalação de lacres conforme necessidade de regularização da ligação;
  • Seguir as normas internas relacionadas as áreas de qualidade, meio ambiente, compliance, saúde e segurança do trabalho, dentre outras, em busca da melhoria contínua.

Requisitos e qualificações

Requisitos e Qualificações:

  • Ensino médio completo;
  • Desejável CNH categoria B definitiva e válida.

Domínio do pacote Office; Perfil colaborativo e organizado. Na Iguá Saneamento valorizamos a diferença em todos os contextos e trabalhamos para promover uma cultura ética e inclusiva sempre. Como companhia e time, buscamos a equidade e respeitamos todos os tipos de diversidade (Gênero, Deficiência - PCD, LGBTQIAPN+, Étnico racial, Crenças e Gerações). Venha fazer parte dessa mudança, acreditamos na força de cada individualidade para gerar transformação

Informações adicionais

Nossos Benefícios


Aqui, cuidamos das nossas pessoas em todas as etapas da sua jornada como colaborador. Conheça o que oferecemos:


Saúde, bem-estar e qualidade de vida

  • Plano de Saúde extensivo aos dependentes

  • Acesso à rede credenciada de estabelecimentos diversos, como academias e estúdios (TotalPass)
  • Rede de parcerias e descontos em produtos e serviços

Desenvolvimento e Carreira

  • Programas de mentoria pontuais

Em 2017, nascemos com um propósito:ser a MELHOR empresa de saneamento PARA o Brasil.


Desde então, somos uma das principais empresas do setor no país e estamos presentes em seis estados brasileiros (Alagoas, Mato Grosso, São Paulo, Paraná, Rio de Janeiro e Sergipe), beneficiando milhões de pessoas com os serviços prestados por nossas concessões e parcerias público-privadas. Atuamos com o compromisso de proporcionar qualidade de vida e saúde à população atendida por meio de um trabalho de qualidade no fornecimento de água tratada e de coleta, afastamento e tratamento de esgoto. Em 2024, fomos eleitos, pelo 8º ano consecutivo, uma ótima empresa para se trabalhar pela consultoria Great Place to Work (GPTW).

Mais do que uma atividade empresarial, encaramos a universalização do saneamento básico como um compromisso de larga escala com a vida, as pessoas, o meio ambiente, os parceiros e o desenvolvimento sustentável do Brasil.

O nosso jeito de ser é marcado pelo DNA inovador que proporciona um ambiente acolhedor, respeitoso e de muitos aprendizados, gerando grande impacto na sociedade. A valorização e o respeito as diferenças estão presentes na empresa para promover uma cultura ética e inclusiva sempre e um ambiente psicologicamente seguro para mulheres, pessoas com deficiência, pessoas negras, pessoas LGBTQIA+, independente de suas crenças, idade ou qualquer outro marcador social ou identitário. Buscamos a equidade e respeito e em nossas equipes então venha fazer parte dessa mudança, acreditamos na força de cada individualidade para gerar transformação Já somos mais de 2.500 colaboradores e estamos expandindo em um ritmo acelerado e com perspectiva para muito mais

Você alguma vez já se perguntou sobre seu propósito e qual história quer escrever para a sua vida e carreira? Sempre sonhou em ter papel protagonista na sua carreira e impactar a vida de milhares de pessoas? Você pode fazer parte disso

title: R Engineer
description:
As a remote, hourly paid R Engineer, you will review AI-generated responses and generate high-quality R and data-analysis-focused content, evaluating the reasoning quality and step-by-step problem-solving behind each solution. You will assess solutions for accuracy, clarity, and adherence to the prompt; identify errors in statistical methodology or data-wrangling workflows; fact-check analytical results; write expert-level explanations and model solutions that demonstrate correct use of R; and rate and compare multiple AI responses based on correctness and reasoning quality. This contract role is with SME Careers, a fast-growing AI Data Services company and subsidiary of SuperAnnotate that provides AI training data for many of the world's largest AI companies and foundation model labs, directly helping to improve the world's premier AI models.
Key Responsibilities
Develop AI Training Content: Create detailed prompts in various topics and responses to guide AI learning, ensuring the models reflect a comprehensive understanding of diverse subjects.
Optimize AI Performance: Evaluate and rank AI responses to enhance the model's accuracy, fluency, and contextual relevance.
Ensure Model Integrity: Test AI models for potential inaccuracies or biases, validating their reliability across use cases.
Your Profile
2+ years of hands-on experience using R for data analysis, statistics, or data science work.
Strong proficiency in R programming, including data wrangling, functional programming patterns, and writing reusable functions or packages.
Solid grounding in applied statistics, including regression, inference, and model validation, with practical experience implementing these methods in R.
Experience building end-to-end analyses in R that include data cleaning, exploratory analysis, modeling, and visualization.
Familiarity with common R ecosystems such as tidyverse, , and ggplot2, and the ability to choose appropriate tools for a given task.
Professional experience in a data-focused role such as data scientist, statistician, quantitative analyst, or similar.
Minimum Bachelor's degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a closely related quantitative field.
Significant experience using large language models (LLMs) to assist with coding, analysis design, and code review in R.
Excellent English writing skills with the ability to document analyses and explain complex statistical ideas clearly to non-experts.
Previous experience with AI data training or model evaluation is strongly preferred, and Minimum C1 English proficiency is required.

O Guanabara também inovou no calendário varejista do estado do Rio de Janeiro e criou campanhas promocionais como: Semana da Beleza, Semana da Limpeza, Guanababy, Black Fraldas e o tradicional Aniversário Guanabara
A rede já foi eleita pela revista Veja Rio como "A marca mais amada do Rio" e por 15 anos pela pesquisa "Marcas dos Cariocas", em parceria com O Globo, a "Marca preferida dos Cariocas".
E você sabe qual o segredo de todo esse sucesso? São os 14 mil talentos que compõem esse time campeão.
